name: blueprint/merge-arbiter
description: Neutral resolution of merge conflicts between two agents: capture the diff, extract both intents, propose a merge, verify with the gate
ingredients: rh_text_extract side A / side B intents
recipe: capture the conflict diff -> extract each side's intent and cite -> propose a resolution that honors both -> apply, verify with the same tests, gate the result
pitfalls: record both intents BEFORE proposing - the arbiter is neutral or it is nothing
the cite on each intent keeps the resolution falsifiable
verify with the same command that reproduced (debug-loop)
